dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Nam, do we go to the temple by car or bike?
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːm, duː wiː ˈɡoʊ tə ðə ˈtɛmpəl baɪ ˈkɑːr ɔːr ˈbaɪk?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: We go by subway and then by boat.
dialogue.reading: wiː ˈɡoʊ baɪ ˈsʌbweɪ ənd ˈðɛn baɪ ˈboʊt.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: We get on the subway here.
dialogue.reading: wiː ˈɡɛt ˈɑːn ðə ˈsʌbweɪ ˈhɪr.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: And where do we get off?
dialogue.reading: ənd ˈwɛr duː wiː ˈɡɛt ˈɔːf?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: At the next station. Then we get on a boat.
dialogue.reading: ət ðə ˈnɛkst ˈsteɪʃən. ˈðɛn wiː ˈɡɛt ˈɑːn ə ˈboʊt.
